questions.q: What formula does Joy use to help passengers regain control?
questions.why: Joy introduces the E + P = O formula early in the bus lessons.

questions.q: Who is described as the Chief Energy Officer of his own bus?
questions.why: Joy tells George he is the CEO/Chief Energy Officer of his bus.

questions.q: Which rule states that enthusiasm attracts others to your bus?
questions.why: The seventh rule explains enthusiasm draws people onto the bus.

questions.q: What does Joy advise George to do to fulfill people's need for appreciation?
questions.why: Joy's three actions focus on loving, listening, and appreciating others.

questions.q: What event prompts George to start riding the bus?
a: His car breaks down on a Monday
He moves to a new city
questions.why: George's car breaks down, forcing him onto the bus for two weeks.
